title: Close-time pattern check door with blocking violated verdict
action: Per U7: `bee close` (and --dry-run) gains a pattern-check door — map the feature's cells' touched files to bundle areas, list those areas' critical patterns, and read a per-pattern verdict (violated/respected/not-applicable) supplied by the closing agent via a flag or answers file (pick the smallest transport the close call already supports; document it in the door's own detail text). Unanswered patterns report as pending (non-blocking); a recorded `violated` blocks close exactly like a red test, naming the pattern. Verdicts persist on the existing close/trace records — no new artifact file. TDD: violated blocks, respected/n-a pass, absent answers report pending.

No verdicts = pending report, close proceeds on green tests
